name: FanState
meaning: Fan state (u8 at Fan+0x8c), index into g_fanStateAnims 0x576010

name: FAN_ST_WORLD
meaning: on the ground / in a container: anim 3, shadow shown

name: FAN_ST_HELD
meaning: held, off: anim 2 once, shadow hidden (msg 4, msg 0x16)

name: FAN_ST_SPIN_UP
meaning: msg 0x15: anim 4 once, blows every frame; -> 3 when the anim finishes

name: FAN_ST_BLOWING
meaning: anim 0 looped, blows every frame, whirr loop 0x6c
